pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are irregularly polygonal with varying eccentricity. Edges exhibit moderately sharp pixel gradients. Patches on the lower neck are vertically elongated, while those on the flank are more equilateral with rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial space forming trivalent and quadrivalent junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively consistent throughout the mid-neck, with slight broadening at intersections on the lower flank.
